''See also: [[Goldsteel Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Goldsteel is a rare and valuable metallic substance characterized by its appearance as polished gold that reflects a pure [[white light]] when it catches the sun, creating a visual sensation that can confuse the observer. Unlike [[halfsilver]], which is used to disrupt [[madra]], goldsteel possesses the unique ability to provide protection against [[Remnants]] and can firmly grip or manipulate immaterial [[madra]] without passing through it. Because of these properties, the material is highly sought after for [[Soulsmithing]] tools—such as scalpels, tongs, and hooks—as well as for specialized defensive equipment like breastplates, mail, shields, and [[chains]]. It is also utilized in the construction of advanced [[constructs]] to restrain excess power or create sturdy [[scripts]] for boundary fields. Additionally, certain clans use the metal's deceptive light-reflecting qualities to assist in training specific paths of [[vital aura]].}}
